description: Відомості про транспортні засоби, які обслуговують пасажирські автобусні, тролейбусні та трамвайні маршрути перевезення (кількість транспортних засобів на кожному маршруті, марка, модель, державний номер, пасажиромісткість) is a dataset listed in data.gov.ua, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Яремчанська міська рада. The set contains data on carriers and vehicle numbers serving passenger bus, trolleybus and tram transportation routes. Coverage: Яремчанська міська рада. The portal shows the English title as "Information about vehicles serving passenger bus, trolleybus and tram transportation routes (number of vehicles on each " (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Яремчанська міська рада. Its keywords include марка, тролейбус, маршрут, доступність, трамвай, транспорт. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua.
